lines: Can your choices change what others do?
Other people watch and learn from your choices.
These penguins walk together in large groups to the sea to find food.
But the sea can be dangerous.
Leopard seals might be waiting to catch them.
So the penguins stop near the water.
None of them wants to go in first.
After some time, however, one brave penguin finally jumps in.
The others carefully watch, waiting to see what will happen.
If that first penguin survives and swims back, the rest follow it.
If it gets caught by a seal and never comes back, they turn around and leave.
One penguin’s action decides what the others do next.
The group watches and learns from what they see.
Their simple rule is: “learn and live.”
